description: Use when an agent needs the official inflation rate (year-on-year consumer prices) for a country: Eurostat HICP for the euro area, EU and 36 European countries (incl. CH, NO, TR) and US CPI-U from the Bureau of Labor Statistics. Latest month plus up to 36 months of history, flash estimates flagged. Source named in every answer. Bad input: HTTP 400 before payment; outage is not charged. Price: 0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

country.description: 2-letter code: EA, EU, AT, BE, BG, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EE, EL, ES, FI, FR, HR, HU, IE, IT, LT, LU, LV, MT, NL, PL, PT, RO, SE, SI, SK, IS, NO, CH, TR, AL, ME, MK, RS, XK, US. EA = euro area, EU = European Union.

months.description: Number of months of history, 1-36. Default 12.
